system.description:
Your hands glow a pinkish hue as you get ready to devastate your target. Make a melee ninjutsu (or taijutsu) attack, dealing [Unarmed damage] + 2d8 Necrotic damage, and regain hit points equal to half the damage dealt.

Finisher: Make a second attack against the same creature, dealing [Unarmed Damage] + 2d8 but as chakra damage. You gain temporary chakra points equal to half the result of this jutsu’s d8 damage die.

Monstrous Burst. On a hit, force the affected creature to make a Constitution saving throw. On a failure, they become Bruised.

Healers Touch. On a hit, force the affected creature to make a Constitution saving throw. On a failure, any Physical condition you have ranks of, reduce the ranks of the chosen condition by 1, and the affected creature gains 1 rank of the same condition.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above D-Rank increase the cost of the jutsu by 3 and increase the damage by 1d8. If you cast this jutsu at A-Rank or higher you instead regain hit point equal to the total damage dealt.
